r0.title: I sent the brief
r0.text: The task text and a link to the file

r1.title: Brief and style board
r1.text: Visual research, 6 directions, up to 4 questions

r2.title: I picked the style
r2.text: I answered questions, then the tool went on alone

r3.title: Stage 1
r3.text: Research, screen map, file, tokens, wireframes, audit

r4.title: Review, then “go”
r4.text: Notes became rules; stage 2 waited for my word

r6.title: The stop
r6.text: I reviewed the screens while the icons were drawn

r7.title: Everything else
r7.text: Branches, prototype, cover, 28 icons, two store sets, audit

r8.title: I walked the file
r8.text: I fixed it or sent it back, then review

r9.title: Close
r9.text: What was new from the task went into the base

board.label: Style direction
board.why: The tool recommends C. Lavender is the calmest on a night screen, and one accent holds the main button.

compare.label: Compare wireframe and screen
compare.caption: A made-up app: the same frames and coordinates, a wireframe becomes a screen in place.

shelf.caption: A made-up app, mockups in vector. I show the real files in conversation.

s0.title: Note
s0.text: The menu dropped below the button.

s1.title: Rule
s1.text: A menu from a button takes the button’s place: the menu’s top right corner matches the button’s.

s2.title: Critic
s2.text: Read this checklist on every frame with a menu and compared the two.

s3.title: Repeat
s3.text: The note came back on the next task, so the rule was not read in time: a repeat mark and a move into the main rules.

s4.title: Script
s4.text: The audit compared the corners of menu and button. From then on a machine checked it.

app.welcomeText: One line each morning. The pattern shows up within a week.
app.benefit3: Notes that stay on this phone
app.memo: Coffee after five. Fell asleep slowly.

transcript.title: Terminal
transcript.text: A record of the made-up task’s run. With the script on, it plays here live.
transcript.lines:
$ new-app 000
  ✓ s1.brief       quick brief
  ✓ s1.board       style board, waiting
  ? direction: C
  ✓ s1.wireframes  wireframes and critic
  ✓ s1.audit       empty
  ✓ stage 1 ready, waiting for review
$ edits
  note → rule in a checklist
$ stage-2
  ✓ s2.key         onboarding, paywall, main feature
  ? stop: accepted
  ✓ s2.audit       empty
  ✓ stage 2 ready
$ done

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.label: Terminal output
terminal.intro: This is a replay on a made-up task: there is no agent on the page. The commands are the ones from that job.
terminal.unknown: no command {x}. help lists them all.
terminal.noFile: no note {x}. ls lists them all.
terminal.askStyle: Style direction? A B C D E F. A person decides
terminal.askStop: Stop. I review onboarding, paywall, main feature
terminal.autoChosen: the replay picked {x}. On a real task the stage waited for me.
terminal.autoNext: the replay said “next”. On a real task the stage waited for me.
terminal.stage2Done: stage 2 ready, the file can be viewed
terminal.closed: task closed, what is new went into the base
terminal.broke: the session broke at {x}. continue resumes from that step.
terminal.waitingFor: the stage is waiting for: {x}. It does not go on without an answer.
terminal.nothing: nothing to resume, the run is over. run starts it again.
terminal.running: task 000 is already running. state shows where.
terminal.freeRemark: noted: “{x}”. The real sorting is done by the tool, which is not running here.
